spec_match.rationale: Calls the exact surface: decodingInfo() with keySystemConfiguration.video.encryptionScheme using the EME scheme vocabulary (cenc, cbcs, cbcs-1-9).

interactive.rationale: Real controls trigger real decodingInfo() promises; every readout is the browser's actual answer.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index blurb matches what the page does.

edge_cases.rationale: Missing API, rejected key systems (no CDM), and unsupported combinations are all shown as labelled real outcomes, never fake success.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/4644898109259776 and the spec section for encryptionScheme.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite's unrecognized-scheme-refused assertion mirrors the litmus contract: an ignoring browser fails it (verified failing honestly on pre-152 Chromium 141).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via CDP: controls clicked, real answers read back, console and network clean, desktop+mobile screenshots inspected.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts cover the ran/fallback branches with the observed values in details.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; verdict colours pair accent-emerald/accent-rose with near-white backgrounds and are duplicated in text.

accessibility.rationale: Native selects/buttons with labels, 44px targets, tables with scoped headers and aria-labels, role=status result panels.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: responsive-check ok on both classes after adding <wbr> breaks to the long feature H1; the matrix table scrolls inside its own overflow-x container on mobile.

openQuestions.title: Cross-check planner verdicts against the ignored-member detector
openQuestions.detail: On pre-152 browsers the planner's cbcs answer is unscoped (member ignored). The page links the detector; consider surfacing the litmus result inline so the plan carries a trust level.

guidanceConsulted.query: announce decision result live region plan card
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Group decision output under a live region so the plan change is announced.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The plan card is aria-live=polite with heading+body updated together; the planner now refuses a recommendation when the inline litmus proves the member is ignored.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: plan card markup in cbcs-rollout-planner/index.html; CDP run produced the honest no-encrypted-playback plan

summary: Verified with headless Chromium 141 via CDP: real cenc/cbcs queries produced the honest no-encrypted-playback plan for Clear Key + H.264 on this build; raw answers displayed verbatim; console/network clean on both classes.
